design_dispositions: Reuse canonical ValidationScope for2D/3D/cube construction rather than another policy Boolean or copied poll/pop routine. Actual optional scope absence expresses Uncaptured policy; scope presence owns actual device+guard.

Optional cube-face context is actual observation-resource availability, not a separate role tag requiring another enum. Supplied context must still choose canonical policy; None performs native creation without validation-only blocking. Browser cfg excludes synchronous scope creation.

Existing TextureViewOperation should own CubeFace only in its face variant, while shared TextureViewError::Observation owns requested format and actual scope cause. Avoid a second face error type, optional face field for unrelated operations, per-failure operation duplication or legacy API preservation.

Move face selectors to existing cube/views.rs responsibility; retain construction, readback, clearing and submission/backpressure ownership. Alias WgpuTextureView only disambiguates SDK type from application wrapper, not a compatibility alias.
Keep native cube layer indexing and descriptor layer counts at SDK boundary; preserve original typed requested format independently from effective native linear projection.

Generic texture constructor Result APIs may propagate canonical ValidationScopeError with standard conversion; typed view/face APIs retain TextureViewResult through all face selectors. No wrapper conversions/manual error traits required.
